query: I want to streamline our deployment workflow. A speaker says that if you do not add back at least 10% of the items removed, you did not delete enough. Should we use this as a target? The release checklist includes a rollback check and a recovery owner. What should I cut?
expected_behavior: Rejects both a deletion quota and an add-back target; if it explains the remark, says it is a personal heuristic about some removed items needing restoration, not an empirically grounded threshold
Inspects what each candidate step protects and who owns it before proposing removal
Preserves rollback verification and a named recovery owner unless equivalent recovery is evidenced
Suggests reversible candidates and a falsifiable check instead of deleting steps to satisfy a quota
